title: Monotonicity under setting a bit
statement: For any map $M : \mathbb{Z} \to \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ and integer $z$, every integer at which $M$ is true is also one at which the map obtained by setting its value at $z$ to true is true.
hypotheses_covered: M is a function from integers to Booleans
